messages:
Noah Kim: Hey team, I start Monday as an AE. Quick setup list: CRM seat (SFDC), Dialpad softphone + number, Gong + onboarding playlists, edit access to AE call kit and pitch deck, and the regional target list. Who should I ping for each?
Riley Park: Welcome Noah! Send your work email and region. I can do SFDC + target list.
Noah Kim: noah.kim@redwood.ai, region = Pacific NW. Thanks Riley. Edit rights on call kit would help.
Jules Martin: Ill take Dialpad + Gong. For Dialpad, we use softphone + mobile forwarding. If you want, I can port a vanity caller ID for you.
Noah Kim: Prefer a local 206 number if available. Also, any quick best-practice on voicemail greeting?
Jules Martin: Use this short script: "Hi, this is Noah from Redwood Inference. Sorry I missed you 3 I'll follow up by email. Could we grab 15 minutes next week?" Upload via Settings > Voicemail. Enable transcription so voicemails land in email.
Ops Bot: Ticket PRV-2699 created for SFDC seat, Dialpad number, Gong access, and collateral perms. ETA ~8 hours.
Riley Park: Added you to CRM view "PNW Targets" and sent invite. Also uploaded target list CSV to Sales Drive.
Terry Nguyen: Dropping links: AE call kit: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/ae-call-kit ; Pitch deck: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/pitch-deck-v3 ; Demo creds: 1Password > Sales/Demos. I'll grant edit to the call kit now.
Noah Kim: Got CRM invite; call kit edit permission still pending.
Terry Nguyen: Fixed 3 should be able to edit now. Also added you to #ae-mentors and scheduled a 30-min buddy session with Riley on Wed 11am.
Jules Martin: Gong invite sent. Shared playlist "Ramp - First Week" and uploaded 6 exemplar calls. Watch the 2 short clips on objection handling.
Noah Kim: Thanks everyone 3 dialing the test number now. Dialpad assigned +1-206-555-0137 and forwarding works. All set for now; will flag any follow-ups here. :raised_hands:
Ops Bot: PRV-2699 resolved: all seats provisioned and permissions updated. Ticket closed.
